title: Number of Islands II
description: Given a 2D grid initialized with 0s and a list of operations (row, col) to turn cells into 1s, count the number of islands after each operation.
pseudocode:
1. initialize parent map, count = 0
2. for each operation (r, c):
3.   if cell (r, c) is already 1, continue
4.   mark (r, c) as 1, count++
5.   for each neighbor (nr, nc):
6.     if neighbor is 1 and find(nr, nc) != find(r, c):
7.       union(nr, nc, r, c), count--
8.   add count to results
